stages.name: Naive Negotiator
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to a Trading Post, order acquisition efficiency <@cc.vup>+10%</>, but all <@cc.kw>Pure Gold</> orders in that Trading Post will only trade <@cc.kw>2</> <@cc.kw>Pure Gold</> (not considered as defaulted trade)

stages.name: Conspicuous Investigator
stages.description: When this Operator is assigned to the Reception Room, increases the likelihood of obtaining clues that are already on the Clue Board.
